facts: NASA SP-8119 (section 3.6.1.1.1) recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting dissimilar metals that will touch or be in contact.
The purpose of consulting the electrochemical series is to address electrochemical (galvanic) corrosion that can occur when dissimilar metals touch.
payload.query: What does NASA SP-8119 recommend consulting when selecting dissimilar metals for parts that touch, and what risk is this intended to address?
payload.answer:
Evidence-grounded answer:

- NASA SP-8119 (section 3.6.1.1.1) recommends consulting the electrochemical series for metals when selecting dissimilar metals that will touch or be in contact. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 5dac91e2]
- The purpose of consulting the electrochemical series is to address electrochemical (galvanic) corrosion that can occur when dissimilar metals touch. [nasa-sp-8119.pdf, pp. 130-132, chunk 5dac91e2]
